climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
building_stock: The Melbourne Hawthorn records point to a mixed housing stock where apartments and units sit alongside houses — the Hawthorn smart-lock copy on globallocksmiths.net.au pitches its digital door locks at "residential, commercial, and multi-family properties", and the Hawthorn East provider lists "Apartment and unit lockouts" as a distinct service line from house lockouts — and the one real resident job on the Airtasker Hawthorn VIC page ("Install two Eufy S231 smart locks including drilling holes on two doors") shows retrofit installs here routinely mean cutting new holes into existing door leaves across more than one door, so door-by-door measurement matters more than a single standard fitting.
council_notes: None identified — no returned Melbourne Hawthorn record mentions a heritage overlay, owners-corporation or body-corporate rule, or rental-provider obligation; the multi-family and apartment/unit service lines imply common-property entrances are in scope, but no record evidences a specific approval requirement.
demographic_skew: Demand signals skew toward a high-turnover, part-tenanted population rather than settled owner-occupiers: the Hawthorn East provider sells "Rekeying locks (including after moving house)" beside apartment and unit lockouts, and the Hawthorn smart-lock offer is aimed at multi-family properties — so a meaningful share of enquiries will come from people who have just moved into a unit and want the previous occupant's access cut off.
common_concerns: Irreversible door modification — the Airtasker Hawthorn VIC job is specified as "drilling holes on two doors" for two Eufy S231 units, so residents are weighing permanent cutting into their existing doors before they commit to a retrofit smart lock.

Whether the install is actually done properly — the Hawthorn page on globallocksmiths.net.au leads with "always installed correctly for maximum security", answering a stated worry that a badly fitted smart lock leaves the door less secure than the lock it replaced.

More than one lock per property, including shared hardware — the Airtasker Hawthorn VIC tasks cover a two-door smart lock install and a communal mailbox lock that had to be opened and replaced, and the Hawthorn East list separates apartment and unit lockouts from house lockouts, so quoting one door misses the job.

Smart lock versus a straight rekey or deadlock — the Hawthorn East provider lists "Rekeying locks (including after moving house)" and "Deadlocks supplied and installed" in the same breath as "Digital and smart lock installation", so residents are comparing the smart upgrade against the cheaper mechanical fix.
